topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I called my childhood best friend today, the one I always laughed with, played video games with, and shared secrets. I was excited, having not seen them in years. But when I mentioned some of our old memories, they just sort of paused. Then they said they were sorry, but they didn't really remember much about our time together. I kept talking, filling the silence, bringing up more stories, hoping something would click, but it didn't. I told myself it's not a big deal, maybe they're just having a tough time or it's been too long. I said I'd catch up with them later, but I don't know when I'll actually do it.
